endorsements.name: José Ricardo
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-3441
endorsements.description: The Rock Convert WordPress plugin before 2.11.0 does not sanitise and escape some of its settings, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed (for example in multisite setup)
endorsements.subtitle: CVE
